name: caol.reference_camp_closed_focused_mcw
description: Prospective isolated owner closed-window reference camp journey. Original TestSetup00 archive save is installed unchanged as zero-credit footing; native observations answer only the exercised parts of the selected reference outcome.

forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Observe actual owner-reference camp gear collection and conservation, day/night patrol service, physical closed-window and roof source behavior, and where eligible the same-site natural signal, knowledge, dispatch and physical arrival. Distinguish independent prerequisites, current source conditions and later outcomes; preserve actual failures and run continuity.
proof_targets: source archive and installed save identity, same native World and current camp/actor/site identities
actual item tile-to-NPC collection, usable equipment and conservation through reload
actual day/night patrol roster and service through reload
physical source fuel and intensity, window/door/roof geometry, weather and observed light escape versus smoke positions
eligible native observer opportunity and source-off or occluded comparison as needed
same-site natural signal to knowledge/stalking to dispatch to physical arrival with timestamps and actors
actual outcomes and any eligible departure and return, with material gaps explicit
invariants: archive installation, equipment or fuel placement, and avatar setup are zero-credit preparation
no direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection
a physical source or precommitted fixture does not prove knowledge, dispatch or arrival
do not infer observation from absence without an eligible observer and actual source opportunity
do not invent return deadlines or force actor outcome; retain losses and failed observations
disclose source, geometry, date, weather and continuity; distinguish signal emission, receipt and physical travel
